capabilities: Generate a single random Lorem Ipsum note
Generate a group of interconnected random notes with links, frontmatter and tags
Delete everything in the current vault without confirmation
disambiguation: Not a note-taking helper; the random notes are fake Lorem Ipsum test data for plugin development, not content.
extras: The README warns the commands are dangerous and unbound to hotkeys by design; the wipe command deletes everything with no confirmation.
problem: Plugin developers need throwaway vaults filled with realistic-looking note structures to test their plugins, which otherwise must be created by hand.
summary: Developer tool that generates randomized test vaults with Lorem Ipsum notes, links, frontmatter and tags, and can wipe a vault.
